name: sse-query-invalidator-workspace
//: oxlint and oxlint-tsgolint are pinned to exact versions because JS plugins API is in alpha and not semver-stable

scripts.validate: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && node scripts/check-duplicate-tests.mjs
scripts.test:package: pnpm --filter restale-kit run test:coverage && pnpm run build && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.test:ci: pnpm --filter restale-kit run test:coverage && pnpm run build && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
